mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at 62 degrees near Harriet Park. The moon is in its first quarter phase, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Expect an overnight low of 55 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city has announced that chip seal road treatments will begin on Wednesday, September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to discuss various development projects and site plans around the city.

There is plenty to do this weekend in Verona. Today, enjoy the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival or participate in the Bike the Barns fundraiser. Tomorrow, you can catch a yoga class at Insight Wellness.

In a report covering early September, officers noted an incident on September 5 where they discovered vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields. This appeared to be a social media prank, and no damage was reported.
For those looking for a frozen treat, please be aware that the Verona Culver's is currently closed today for a building remodel and will not be serving a flavor of the day.
